findings.summary: Spec §1.3 (⛔ switch the tick node template from --selfcheck to the real tick entry) is not actually delivered: the switch is inert. tick.md runs `--run "$tick_channel"` only when tick_channel is non-empty, and workflow.yaml seeds `tick_channel: "{{tick_channel}}"` from the pipeline input namespace — but fleet.yaml.tpl declares only `tick_entry: ${TICK_ENTRY}` and never declares a tick_channel input (and deep-research-loop.sh exports no corresponding env var). No path in the assembled system ever supplies tick_channel, so the rendered tick node either falls through to --selfcheck forever (channel empty) or invokes `--run "{{tick_channel}}"` with an unresolved literal channel id. N9 passes only because it greps the template text for `--run`, i.e. exactly the non-discriminative 'wiring proved by textual presence' evidence that spec §0 and §4.1 discipline 8 forbid.

The production spawn wiring required by spec §1.2 ('CAS 成功 ⇒ 调用注入的 spawnWorker(clueId, role, runId)') is an empty no-op in the only real code path: runChannelWrite injects `spawnWorker: async () => {}`. N3/M9 assert spawn only against a test-injected dep, so the real `--run` claims a card to in_flight with a fresh run_id and starts nothing. The dev-note's N13 'spawn 被调用 … spawned: true' evidence is therefore vacuous. Once the template switch of finding 1 is fixed, this yields the exact churn spec §0 warns about: each tick dispatches open→in_flight, no agent.run.started ever appears on board:agent-runs, and the next tick reclaims the card back to open — two irreversible appends per card per tick on an append-only bus. Spec §7 scopes out verifying worker *output*, but it does not sanction a spawn that performs no action at all.

Leftover mutation-marker comments remain in shipped product code and directly contradict the code they annotate: `// V5 mutation: web goes normal dispatch instead of blocked.` sits above the branch that correctly blocks web, and `// V6 mutation: out-of-enum silently skipped instead of blocked.` sits above the branch that correctly blocks out-of-enum sources. These contradict the dev-note's claim of verbatim restoration after the §4 mutation self-check and will mislead future readers about the intended behaviour.
